artifact_observations.reasoning: The legends on the keyboard keys are illegible smudges rather than distinct characters. While expected at this resolution, AI generation often fails to render even plausible key shapes, resulting in melted or nonsensical blobs.

The mechanical hinge connecting the screen and keyboard lacks clear structural definition; it appears slightly fused. The right-side bezel buttons seem to merge into the casing without clear separation lines.
The screen lacks the typical specular highlights or glass-like reflection of an LCD, appearing oddly flat and matte like the plastic casing, suggesting a material rendering error.

Mechanical plausibility of the hinge mechanism
